sloka: रामं च लक्ष्मणं चैव दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवमेव च ।समप्रतिष्ठां जगतीमाकाशान्निपपात ह ।। ५.६२.३८ ।।।।
transliteration: rāmaṁ ca lakṣmaṇaṁ caiva dṛṣṭvā sugrīvameva ca ।samapratiṣṭhāṁ jagatīmākāśānnipapāta ha ।। 5.62.38 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing Rama, Lakshmana and also Sugriva from the sky he landed on an even ground.
